title: Dedicated capacity - weekly prep (1:1) - Alex M
body:
Meeting: Dedicated capacity - weekly sync / 1:1 prep
Date (for this note): 2024-12-06
Owner: Alex Martinez
Attendees (expected): Jordan Lee, Priya Desai (prod ops), Kelsey Park (sales eng)
Goal: Align on near-term reservations, autoscaling tweaks, and customer commitments that affect pool sizing. Prepare asks for finance (reserve vs on-demand cost) and sales (firmness of bookings).

Top-level summary / decision needs:
- Current utilization trend: 72% average GPU utilization across A100-40 pools last 30d; 95th pctk request latency within SLO.
- Forecast ask: propose +30 A100-40 reservations for Q1 (Jan-Mar) to support three mid-market customers (estimated commit: 300M tokens/month combined) + buffer for PLG growth.
- Autoscaling: current scale-up threshold 80% avg queue depth. Observed oscillation during midday bursts; consider increase cooldown or add predictive warm-up for recurring jobs.
- Burst capacity: keep 10% of pool unreserved (burst) to handle spikes; confirm with finance on cost impact.

Notes / data points to reference in meeting:
- Pool inventory (as of 2024-12-03):
  - a100-40: reserved 160, active 152 (8 in maintenance)
  - h100-80: reserved 40, active 40
  - t4: reserved 120, active 118
- 30d usage by customer (top 5):
  - CustA: 28% of tokens (steady), largely seq len 1-128 -> cheap per-token
  - CustB: 18% (churny, periodic training-like workloads)
  - CustC: 12% (recent spike, trial)
- Recent incident: 2024-11-20 midday queue spike due to model rollout; autoscaler scaled but with 6m latency to reach target pods -> investigation: scale-down cooldown too short, scale-up policy linear rather than step.

Forecast assumptions for Q1 ask (+30 A100-40):
- PLG growth baseline: 10% month-over-month (conservative)
- Sales pipeline: 2 signed pilots converting to paid in Jan-Feb (combined 120M tokens/mo)
- Safety buffer: 20% capacity to absorb model changes / higher seq lengths
- Pricing tradeoff: Reserved A100-40 reduces per-token infra cost by ~35% vs on-demand (finance to confirm exact $).

Risks / open questions:
- Commitment risk: Sales needs to confirm start dates for pilots; if delayed, reservations will be idle and cost-negative. Need a mitigation (convert to flexible commit or allow 1-month ramp).
- Migration risk: if we push customers to quantized models, effective capacity improves but we need to validate quality regression risk. Who owns eval? (Prod ML team?)
- Autoscaling side effects: warm cache requirement for low-latency customers (we should prioritize pre-warmed nodes for high-SLA customers).

Proposed adjustments to autoscaler (ops proposals to discuss):
- Increase scale-up aggressiveness: allow step-scaling when queue depth > 120% of target for 2 consecutive checks (current is 3).
- Add 10m warm-up window for recurring daily jobs: detect cron-like pattern and keep min-ready nodes for that window.
- Increase scale-down cooldown from 5m to 12m to avoid thrash during midday bursts.
- Implement per-tenant warm pool reservation for top-2 customers (configurable flag).

Conversation agenda (1:1 focus items):
1) Validate +30 A100 ask and contingency plan if sales dates slip.
2) Walk through recent spike incident and assign follow-ups on autoscaler tuning.
3) Discuss finance ask: need a quick cost model (reserved vs burst) to present to CFO next week.
4) Confirm which customers require pre-warm nodes and how to tag them in routing.
5) Decide on rollout plan for autoscaler changes (canary on dev -> staging -> prod; timeline estimate 2 weeks total).

Action items (with owners & target dates):
- AI-1: Prepare Q1 reserved capacity request doc (numbers + cost delta) -> Alex Martinez -> due 2024-12-10
- AI-2: Run autoscaler replay for 2024-11-20 incident and produce root-cause summary -> Jordan Lee -> due 2024-12-08
- AI-3: Finance model: compute monthly cost delta for +30 A100 reservations vs mixed on-demand -> Priya Desai -> due 2024-12-09
- AI-4: Sales confirmation: get firm start dates for CustB and CustC pilots (impact on reservation start) -> Kelsey Park -> due 2024-12-07
- AI-5: Prod-ML to validate quantization impact on CustA workloads (quality regression + perf) -> Priya Desai / ML -> due 2024-12-17
- AI-6: Ops implement canary for autoscaler tuning on staging, include monitoring dashboards -> Jordan Lee -> due 2024-12-18

Quick talking points for 1:1 with manager (Michael R):
- Emphasize need for quick decision on +30 A100 to secure capacity before price increase window (finance said procurement window closes mid-Dec).
- Highlight autoscaler thrash causing customer-visible latency spikes; propose prioritized ops time to fix.
- Ask for headcount help if follow-ups pile up (1 IC for 2 weeks on autoscaler can speed canary).

Notes to self / scratchpad (questions to ask during meeting):
- Is the +30 ask best expressed as "30 A100-40 reserved" or a mixed A100/H100 split? (H100 expensive but denser for certain models)
- Can we negotiate flexible start dates with procurement to avoid paying for idle months?
- Should we create a "burst pool" billing flag to properly attribute costs to customers who cause spikes?

References / quick links:
- Incident replay doc: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/OPS/2024-11-20+dedicated-spike
- Current pool metrics dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/hosted/pool-utilization
- Dedicated capacity plan (master): https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/OPS/Dedicated+Capacity+Plan

End of prep note.
